svg.text: combinational: the keep meets its slots at the compact in the same clock cycle
Looks for the test pattern in the samples.
If not found: tries the next bit offset, then waits
until the samples of the new offset arrive.
When found: keeps the offset and reports it as locked.
register setting or status of the block it sits on
The data path of ad408x_phy. The filter_rdy_n bits travel with the data bits
through the alignment and the packers. device_code selects the bit depth: the
packer, the offset limit of the search and, for 20 bits, keep[0] for both slots.
Without the filter (filter_enable = 0 or EN_FILTER_RDY = 0) every present
sample is kept. The lane join is only built with two lanes; with one sample per
adc_data word the slot keep and the compact stage are left out.
bit i belongs to slot i; a 20-bit sample takes both slots,
its keep[0] is used for both
